title: AutoFarmCarrot
description: A lightweight Fabric mod designed to automate carrot farming by efficiently harvesting and replanting crops.
body:
AutoFarmCarrot is a lightweight and efficient utility mod designed for Minecraft 1.21.4. Built on the Fabric loader, this mod focuses on automating the tedious aspects of farming to help players manage their resources better.

Key Features:

Key binds: R

Automatic Harvesting: The mod detects fully grown carrots and harvests them automatically.

Instant Replanting: It automatically places new seeds back into the farmland after harvesting.

High Performance: Designed to run smoothly without causing lag on your Minecraft client.

Easy Setup: Simple to use and requires no complex configuration.

Installation:

Ensure you have the Fabric Loader installed for version 1.21.4.

Add the Fabric API to your mods folder.

Drop the AutoFarmCarrot jar file into the mods directory.
